nodes.description: Immutable constant WETH address used as the base token of every Uniswap pair queried by the oracle.
Immutable constant PHNX token address, the asset whose price the oracle reports.
Immutable constant address of the Uniswap V2 factory used to build factoryInterface.
IUniswapV2Factory instance used to resolve WETH/token pair addresses via getPair.
Mapping address=>uint256 storing the last cumulative token price per pool.
Mapping address=>uint256 storing the last cumulative ETH price per pool.
Mapping address=>uint32 holding the pair blockTimestampLast snapshot, used to compute timeElapsed.
Mapping address=>uint256 holding the token-side cumulative reserve reference for the TWAP.
Mapping address=>uint256 holding the ETH-side cumulative reserve reference for the TWAP.
Mapping address=>uint32 storing the wall-clock block.timestamp of the last oracle refresh; drives staleness checks.
Constructor initializing factoryInterface from UNISWAP_V2_FACTORY and seeding prices for PHNX.
Public refresh routine that pulls current cumulative prices from the pool and updates all oracle mappings and lastTokenTimestamp.
External price entrypoint returning the token price in ETH terms; refreshes values when stale and emits AssetValue.
External entrypoint returning the PHNX/ETH TWAP price, computing timeElapsed from the two stored timestamps.
Internal helper resolving the pool for a token and returning the TWAP-derived ETH amount per token.
Public view computing the time-weighted asset value; divides the cumulative delta by timeElapsed and scales by token decimals.
Miner-influenceable block timestamp used for staleness checks, refresh scheduling and TWAP time windows.
Division by the caller-derived timeElapsed in _calculate without a zero guard, causing revert or truncation errors.
uint32(block.timestamp % 2**32) truncation that discards high bits and wraps the timestamp counter.
SafeMath subtraction of uint32 timestamps (lastTokenTimestamp - tokenToTimestampLast) that reverts on underflow and can be manipulated around the refresh window.
token argument of setValues, the asset whose pool is refreshed.
token argument of fetch, the asset being priced.
token argument of _getAmounts, used to resolve the WETH pair.
latestCommulative argument of _calculate, the newest cumulative price reading.
oldCommulative argument of _calculate, the stored cumulative price baseline.
timeElapsed argument of _calculate used as the denominator of the TWAP.
token argument of _calculate used to query ERC20 decimals.
Local pool address resolved by factoryInterface.getPair in setValues.
Returned price computed in fetch as ethPerToken * 1e18 / ethPerPhnx.
Local ETH-per-PHNX value obtained via _getAmounts(PHNX) in fetch.
Local ETH-per-token value obtained via _getAmounts(token) in fetch.
Local uint32 timestamp computed as block.timestamp % 2**32 inside currentBlockTimestamp.
Local uq112x112 TWAP price built in _calculate from the cumulative delta divided by timeElapsed.
Local uint32 window length derived from lastTokenTimestamp[PHNX] - tokenToTimestampLast[PHNX].
Local pair address resolved in _getAmounts; zero means no pool and returns 0.
Local ERC20 decimals of the priced token, fetched via an external call.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns factoryInterface from the UNISWAP_V2_FACTORY constant.
Constructor reads the UNISWAP_V2_FACTORY constant to build the factory interface.
Constructor invokes setValues(PHNX) to seed the initial oracle state.
Constructor passes the PHNX constant into setValues.
setValues calls factoryInterface.getPair(WETH, token) to resolve the pool.
setValues uses the WETH constant as one side of the queried pair.
setValues consumes its token parameter for pair lookup and mapping keys.
setValues writes cummulativeAveragePrice[token] from currentCumulativePrices.
setValues writes cummulativeEthPrice[token] from currentCumulativePrices.
setValues writes tokenToTimestampLast[token] with the pool blockTimestampLast.
setValues writes cummulativeAveragePriceReserve[token] from price0/1CumulativeLast.
setValues writes cummulativeEthPriceReserve[token] from price0/1CumulativeLast.
setValues writes lastTokenTimestamp[token] directly from block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
block.timestamp flows into lastTokenTimestamp inside setValues, making the refresh schedule timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is truncated modulo 2**32 into the uint32 timestamp used by the TWAP library.
fetch compares block.timestamp minus lastTokenTimestamp against a 3 minute threshold, a timestamp-dependent branch.
fetchPhnxPrice performs the same block.timestamp staleness comparison for PHNX.
fetch conditionally calls setValues(token) when cached prices are stale.
fetch calls _getAmounts to obtain ETH-denominated values.
fetch reads cummulativeAveragePrice[token] for the staleness guard.
fetch reads lastTokenTimestamp to decide whether a refresh is required.
fetch always prices the PHNX constant in addition to the requested token.
fetch computes and returns the local price value.
fetch stores the result of _getAmounts(PHNX) in ethPerPhnx.
fetch stores the result of _getAmounts(token) in ethPerToken.
fetchPhnxPrice conditionally calls setValues(PHNX) when values are stale.
fetchPhnxPrice derives the timeElapsed window from the two stored timestamps.
timeElapsed is produced by subtracting uint32 timestamps, which reverts on underflow and is tightly coupled to the refresh window.
fetchPhnxPrice delegates the TWAP computation to _calculate.
_getAmounts calls factoryInterface.getPair(WETH, token) to find the pool.
_getAmounts stores the resolved pair address in the poolAddress local.
_getAmounts reads lastTokenTimestamp[token], a timestamp-derived state value.
_getAmounts reads tokenToTimestampLast[token] to build timeElapsed.
_getAmounts calls _calculate to convert cumulative deltas into an ETH value.
_calculate divides the cumulative delta by timeElapsed without verifying timeElapsed is non-zero.
The timeElapsed parameter is the unguarded divisor of the unsafe operation.
_calculate consumes the latestCommulative parameter as the upper cumulative reading.
_calculate consumes the oldCommulative parameter as the baseline cumulative reading.
_calculate builds the priceTemp fixed point value from the cumulative delta.
_calculate reads the token decimals through an external IERC20 call.
_calculate uses the token parameter to query decimals and scale the result.

normalization_plan.reason: Function parameter used only to key the mappings written by setValues.
Function parameter consumed only inside fetch for pricing and staleness checks.
Function parameter used only to resolve the WETH pool inside _getAmounts.
Function parameter used only as the upper cumulative reading in _calculate.
Function parameter used only as the baseline cumulative reading in _calculate.
This parameter is the divisor of the unguarded division, so it collapses into the unsafe arithmetic operation.
Function parameter used only to query ERC20 decimals inside _calculate.
Temporary pair address resolved and immediately consumed within setValues.
Return value local computed and returned inside fetch.
Intermediate ETH-per-PHNX value local to fetch.
Intermediate ETH-per-token value local to fetch.
This local is exactly the truncated uint32 block timestamp, so it folds into the truncation unsafe operation.
Temporary value built directly from the unguarded division in _calculate.
Local produced by the timestamp subtraction and fed into _calculate, folding into that arithmetic operation.
Temporary pair address resolved and used within _getAmounts.
Temporary decimals value read and consumed within _calculate.
